diagnosis: The custom HEAD interceptor for tus resumable uploads looks up the upload purely by uploadId and returns the upload offset, size, and metadata headers. It does not check if req.user.id created the upload, allowing any authenticated user to read sensitive metadata (such as internal employee numbers and customer contract IDs) stored in ongoing uploads of other users.
exploit_request:
HEAD /uploads/up_legal_doc_771890 HTTP/1.1
Host: files.cloudcorp.com
Authorization: Bearer <attacker_jwt>
